analysis.reasonEn: RSI is exiting oversold territory (36.6 → 39.6), but the MACD histogram is worsening (-2.0098 → -2.6944), indicating persistent downward pressure. The absence of a 'Higher Low' pattern, with the 5-day low not surpassing the 20-day low, signals a weak trend reversal. The current price ($658.87) is below the SMA20 ($680.63) and EMA50 ($689.16), trapped within a medium-term resistance zone. ADX at 27.1 indicates a clear trend, but -DI (40.8) significantly exceeds +DI (13.3), showing continued bearish dominance. Therefore, a wait-and-see approach is warranted pending further indicator confirmation.
